def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    mk=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c] not in (0,8)]
    bl=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==8]
    mr0=min(r for r,c in mk); mc0=min(c for r,c in mk)
    mr1=max(r for r,c in mk); mc1=max(c for r,c in mk)
    marker=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(mc0,mc1+1)] for r in range(mr0,mr1+1)]
    bmH,bmW=len(marker),len(marker[0])
    r0=min(r for r,c in bl); c0=min(c for r,c in bl)
    bH=max(r for r,c in bl)-r0+1; bW=max(c for r,c in bl)-c0+1
    s=bH//bmH
    rot=[[marker[bmH-1-j][i] for j in range(bmH)] for i in range(bmW)]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for bi in range(bmH):

            for rr in range(r0+s*bi,r0+s*(bi+1)):
